specs.d: Cups he didn't earn, nothing else
Everything except arrival and soft awards

ladder.name: Cups per point share
ladder.text: Cups divided by career point shares. It rewards being bad: the leader won 4 Cups with fewer than 0 point shares.

ladder.name: Cups he didn't earn
ladder.text: His team's Cup odds with him, minus its odds with his own point shares taken off its standings points, is the part he earned. The rest is luck.

ladder.name: Dragons
ladder.text: The pre-playoff favourite knocked out by somebody else in a year he won the Cup.

ladder.name: Coin flips and bounces
ladder.text: Series that went the distance (double if the last game was decided by one goal), plus playoff goals gained because his team's shooters and goalies ran hot.

ladder.name: Arrival and soft awards
ladder.text: Cups in a player's first or second season with a team, and Hart, Norris or Vezina wins in seasons someone else at his position had more point shares.
